scope: Read-only pre-hover and project-row-hover hit-test of project-level New chat actions and the sidebar resize separator. No prompt was submitted, and no project action was activated.
privacy: Project and task labels and account data are not retained. The cropped screenshot is local-only and contains no row label.

priorUnconfirmedSample.interpretation: Geometry alone did not prove that the project action was visibly presented in this transient state.

localEvidence.description: Small crop of the hovered action and resize boundary; project text is outside the crop.

interpretation: The pre-hover action parent is opacity 0 and the initial DOM rectangle overlaps the separator; after row hover the visible action shifts 34px inboard, clears the separator by 6px, and its center hit resolves inside the button. Current evidence does not establish that a visibly presented action is blocked.
knownLimitations: This is one 1728×1003 dark-theme sample of a single hovered project row; compact widths, other themes, keyboard activation, and resize while focused remain untested.
The prior 1728×1001 sample did not record visibility or parent opacity, so its center-hit result remains unconfirmed as a user-visible reachability defect.
The screenshot is structural/local-only evidence, not an installed-product pixel comparison or global baseline promotion.
